“the stakes for our movement has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our movement have never been higher”

“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”

“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The earlier summary gives a $1 million daily maximum; confirm the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]

“who's support” >>> “whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These categories total 29 members, not 28.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Only five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided. The subsequent discussion also leaves Kowalski’s and Ames’s classifications unclear.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: The timeline dates the committee’s hearing to September 30; clarify whether these are different hearings or correct the date.]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”

“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”

“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary gives an 18-month deadline, not two years; confirm the deadline and what must be completed by then.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“recieve updated talking points” >>> “receive updated talking points”

“Each of our five field organizers” >>> [CHECK: The paragraph previously says there are six field organizers.]
